name: Vesprystus
summary: At Rut'theran Village, Vesprystus sends travelers between Teldrassil and mainland Kalimdor. He tends the hippogryph roost at the great World Tree's base.

sections.title: Keeper of the Rut'theran Roost
sections.body: At Teldrassil's southern base, Vesprystus tends the Rut'theran roost. Trained hippogryphs carry travelers from the isolated elven boughs toward Darkshore and the mainland. A magical portal also links Rut'theran to Darnassus in the canopy above. Across the strait, Vesprystus works with the flight master at Auberdine to carry sentinels, emissaries, and adventurers into Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Vesprystus flies travelers from Rut'theran Village across the water to Auberdine, on the coast of Darkshore. From there, connecting hippogryph routes lead south toward Ashenvale and other night elf enclaves across Kalimdor.

Vesprystus tends a roost of loyal night elf hippogryphs, ancient winged beasts native to northern Kalimdor. Night elves have raised and bonded with them for generations to travel forest canopies and rugged coastlines.

faq.q: How do you reach Darnassus from where Vesprystus stands?
aliases: how to get to darnassus from vesprystus
faq.answer: You can reach Darnassus from Rut'theran Village without a flight. A shimmering pink-tinted portal just up the path from Vesprystus's roost carries travelers to the city canopy.

angles.text: As a young night elf leaving Teldrassil for the first time, you may find Vesprystus ready to send you toward your first glimpse of mainland Kalimdor.
As an Alliance traveler arriving at Teldrassil's docks, you can turn to Vesprystus for swift passage to coastal Darkshore.
